ORBIT / Overlapping fade experiment

Two lights,
one flowing exchange.

Each phase starts a long fade on both LEDs, then shares one wait. Four segments are simpler; eight retain more curve detail. Let nb1 handle timing, and observe the physical light.

Experimental frame contract · no automatic playback. Existing Programs and Patterns keep their semantics. A software preview is not a physical visual acceptance test.

03 / Frozen execution

How nb1 will execute it

nb1 compiles the high-level action into frames. This is the exact result; you do not need to author frames yourself.

Request, receipt, and technical details

Request IDs bind one submission. Daemon IDs prevent an old ticket from targeting a restarted service. Uncertain writes are checked through the original request, never automatically replayed.
